class.name: NavimeshExporter
class.brief_description: Bakes and exports 2D and 3D navigation meshes for third-party servers.
class.description: [NavimeshExporter] is an editor singleton that collects [NavigationRegion2D], [NavigationRegion3D], links, and obstacles, bakes missing meshes, and writes a JSON file plus a compact [code]BNAV[/code] binary twin. The scene payload uses [code]format = "blazium.navimesh"[/code] and [code]version = 1[/code]. Each region, link, and obstacle includes a [code]dimension[/code] of [code]"2d"[/code] or [code]"3d"[/code]. Vertices are written in world space. Combined project exports use [code]format = "blazium.navimesh.bundle"[/code] with a [code]levels[/code] array. Call this API from GDScript, Luau, or C# (GodotSharpEditor), the inspector/toolbar Export button, [code]--export-navmesh[/code], JustAMCP, or remote_control. [codeblocks] [gdscript] NavimeshExporter.bake_node($NavigationRegion3D) NavimeshExporter.export_scene("res://levels/town.tscn", "res://.navimesh_export/") NavimeshExporter.export_project("res://levels/", "res://.navimesh_export/", NavimeshExporter.MODE_COMBINED) [/gdscript] [csharp] NavimeshExporter.Singleton.BakeNode(region); NavimeshExporter.Singleton.ExportScene("res://levels/town.tscn", "res://.navimesh_export/"); [/csharp] [/codeblocks] Headless CLI: [codeblock] blazium --headless --path <project> --export-navmesh --export-navmesh-scenes res://levels/ --export-navmesh-output res://.navimesh_export/ --export-navmesh-mode individual --export-navmesh-format both --export-navmesh-dimension both [/codeblock]

method.name: bake_node
method.description: Synchronously bakes a [NavigationRegion2D] or [NavigationRegion3D]. Emits [signal bake_finished] on success.

method.name: bake_scene
method.description: Loads [param scene_path], bakes matching regions, and returns a summary with [code]ok[/code] and [code]baked[/code] counts.

method.name: collect_from_node
method.description: Builds an in-memory navimesh payload from [param node] without writing files. Region nodes export that region plus same-dimension links.

method.name: export_node
method.description: Bakes then writes JSON and/or binary next to [param output_path]. Link nodes export the whole scene for that dimension.

method.name: export_project
method.description: Scans [param scenes] for [code].tscn[/code]/[code].scn[/code] files and exports them individually or as [code]navimesh_bundle.nav.json[/code] / [code].nav.bin[/code].

method.name: export_scene
method.description: Bakes and exports one scene. Scenes without matching navigation regions are skipped.

method.name: list_scenes
method.description: Returns scene paths under [param root] that contain [NavigationRegion2D] and/or [NavigationRegion3D].

signal.name: bake_finished
signal.description: Emitted after a successful [method bake_node] call.

signal.name: export_finished
signal.description: Emitted after a file export finishes. [param paths] lists written [code].nav.json[/code] and [code].nav.bin[/code] files.

constants.constant: Write JSON and the BNAV binary twin.
Write one file pair per scene.
Write a single bundle containing every exported level.
